Container.Name: StreamHub
Container.Overview:
StreamHub is a self-hosted, unified streaming hub. It brings your Plex and Jellyfin libraries, IPTV (Xtream and M3U) live TV, EPG guide, and deep links to installed streaming apps into one interface for the web and Android TV. Everything runs on your server; clients never talk to source services directly.
Requires you to supply sources you are legally authorized to use. See the legal notice in the app.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the StreamHub web interface and API listen on.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Database, settings and encryption keys. Back this up.

Config.Name: Transcode Path
Config.Description: Scratch space for proxy remux and transcode segments. A RAM-backed path such as /tmp/streamhub-transcode avoids wear on the array.

Config.Name: VA-API Device
Config.Description: Optional. Intel/AMD GPU render device for hardware transcoding. Leave empty for software encoding.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Unraid default for nobody is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default for users is 100.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Required. A long random string used to sign tokens and encrypt source credentials. Changing it invalidates sessions and stored credentials.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. TMDB v3 API key for artwork and metadata. Can also be set in the web UI.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional. Sets the initial admin password. If empty, the first-run screen asks for one.
